items.answer: A well-maintained central AC system typically lasts 15-20 years. If yours is over 15 years old and needs major repair, replacement may be more cost-effective.

items.title: Warm Air
items.description: AC running but not cooling? Could be a refrigerant leak or compressor issue.

items.title: Water Leaks
items.description: Moisture or ice around your unit indicates a drainage or refrigerant problem.

items.title: Unusual Noises
items.description: Grinding, squealing or rattling sounds signal a mechanical problem.

items.title: Weak Airflow
items.description: Poor airflow often means a clogged filter, duct issues, or failing blower motor.

items.title: High Energy Bills
items.description: A sudden spike in utility bills indicates your AC is working harder than it should.

items.title: Frequent Cycling
items.description: AC turning on and off rapidly (short cycling) can damage the compressor.
